from subject import validate_import_path_format


def test_valid_import_path_returns_true():
    assert validate_import_path_format("os.path.join") == (True, None)


def test_valid_import_path_with_single_module_returns_true():
    assert validate_import_path_format("collections.OrderedDict") == (True, None)

    assert validate_import_path_format("a.b.c.d.e") == (True, None)

def test_empty_string_returns_false():
    is_valid, error = validate_import_path_format("")
    assert is_valid is False
    assert error == "Import path cannot be empty"
